newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks seen mixed on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks seen mixed on profit-taking.

text.p: Pakistani stocks are likely to open mixed on Tuesday amid profit-taking after the index soared 3.63 percent to a two-year high on Monday.
"Some profit-taking is likely to filter through in early session but overall the sentiment is strong and the index may close higher," a dealer at a foreign brokerage house said.
On Monday, the Karachi Stock Exchange 100 index rose 67.15 points to close at 1,912.45 amid 137 gainers and 78 losers.
Turnover rose to a record 208 million shares from 145 million in the previous session.
